sources.title: Leases: when to register (PG25)
sources.verified_claim: HMLR guidance sets when leasehold estates must or may be registered and how leases are noted; registration rules do not identify the tenure or remaining term of a sample candidate without the exact title.

sources.title: The leasehold reform legislation (PG27)
sources.verified_claim: The current practice guide reflects commenced leasehold-reform provisions and land-registration procedures. It is procedural guidance, not evidence that a candidate has exercised enfranchisement or right-to-manage rights.

sources.title: Leases: determination (PG26)
sources.verified_claim: HMLR explains how leases may determine and how registered titles are affected; determination requires property-specific facts and documentation.

sources.title: Commonhold White Paper
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The White Paper proposes a reformed commonhold model and a route toward commonhold as the default tenure. Policy direction is not evidence that an existing candidate parcel is commonhold.

sources.title: Government response to the Strengthening leaseholder protections over charges and services consultation
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The government response sets further leaseholder-protection policy on service charges and future commonhold/leasehold reform. Policy commitments and future legislation are not silently treated as current candidate lease terms.

sources.title: Stronger leasehold protections in crackdown on hidden fees
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The July 2026 announcement describes clearer service-charge information and planned enfranchisement implementation. It does not establish any sample candidate's service charge, ground rent or lease length.

sources.title: RPC opinion: impact of draft Commonhold and Leasehold Reform Bill
sources.verified_claim: The RPC gave the draft impact assessment a green rating for analytical quality, but explicitly assesses the evidence and analysis rather than making the draft policy current law.

sources.title: Moving to commonhold: banning leasehold for new flats
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government
sources.verified_claim: The consultation sought views on banning leasehold for new flats and transitional arrangements. Consultation content is not treated as enacted tenure law for existing sample parcels.
